description: Defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connection link layer logic in the Zephyr project, specifically for the LL (Link Layer) connection handling in the Bluetooth controller.

methods.name: lll_conn_init
methods.description: Initializes the BLE connection link layer.

methods.name: lll_conn_reset
methods.description: Resets the BLE connection link layer state.

methods.name: lll_conn_flush
methods.description: Flushes the connection with the specified handle.

methods.name: lll_conn_prepare_reset
methods.description: Prepares the connection layer for reset.

methods.name: lll_conn_abort_cb
methods.description: Callback for aborting a connection procedure.

methods.name: lll_conn_isr_rx
methods.description: Handles received packet interrupt for connection.

methods.name: lll_conn_isr_tx
methods.description: Handles transmit packet interrupt for connection.

methods.name: lll_conn_rx_pkt_set
methods.description: Sets up the receive packet for a connection.

methods.name: lll_conn_tx_pkt_set
methods.description: Sets up the transmit packet for a connection.

methods.name: lll_conn_force_md_cnt_set
methods.description: Sets the forced MD count for connection.
